notes.title: Mordath is now officially on steam!
notes.notes:
I started working on this game about 1 and a half years ago and i will continue. Join the discord for sneak peaks, announcements and more! If you feel like it please leave a suggestion and i may add/change it in my game. I will read all of the suggestions since I want all of you to have a great experience with Mordath. Hope you like what you see and I will see you in the future! Bye Bye.

You can reach me at my email: sketchwiregames@gmail.com
